title: One Strike
paragraphs: “The encounter is expected to happen sooner than planned.”
“Gaelion will go scout, na no!”
With that, the rival transformed and flew off. He’s occasionally useful.
“A turtle as big as a mountain, huh…”
“Naofumi-san, you don’t know what it looks like, do you? Ren and I know because we’ve seen it in the game.”
“Pretty much. But I’ve seen something similar in other online games, so it’s not like I have no idea.”
“In the game, it wasn’t that strong of a boss…”
“Maybe it’s like a giant dragon from a monster-hunting game…”

Father and the others seemed to be weighed down by unease. Well, the Spirit Tortoise is certainly on a larger scale than any of the Wave bosses we’ve faced so far. But once we actually fight it, they’ll realize it’s not that formidable. With the Phoenix and the Qilin not lined up after it this time, it’s just the right opponent for training.
“Oh my? There’s no point in being so scared, Naofumi-chan. Let’s have a drink and lighten the mood!”
“Even at a time like this…?”
“If you’re drunk during a fight, you’ll lose a battle you could’ve won.”
“You need to rest when you can and fight when it’s time. Right, Sasa-chan?”
“Ah… well, yeah. Being a mercenary, I can understand that.”

The older sister cheerfully lightened the mood, and Father and the others gave strained smiles. But the atmosphere seemed a little lighter than before. Even the panda stretched out its limbs and sat in a more relaxed manner. They’re a tough bunch. At least mentally, they seem reliable.
“Whatever happens, happens…”
“We’ll figure it out once we face it.”
“Yeah.”

Silence followed for a while. By the way, the filolials were resting as well. Of course, they didn’t let their guard down despite the distant footsteps echoing. They were resting their bodies like cats pretending to be asleep. About an hour later, the rival returned.
“Welcome back, Gaelion-chan. How was it?”
“It was there, na no! It was huge, na no! And it had lots of familiars, na no!”
“Well, of course. So, how much longer until we encounter it? …Judging by how quickly you returned, it seems pretty close.”
“Na no!”
The tremors were already getting quite close. We were fully prepared for battle.
“I’ll cast an illumination spell now.”

The queen said that and began chanting. A magical orb floated high into the sky, brightly illuminating the surroundings. Father and the others turned their eyes in the direction the rival had returned from. There, in the distance, the Spirit Tortoise was slowly approaching with a rumbling sound.
“Whoa… It really is huge.”
“Oh my.”
“As big as a mountain… Maybe running away would be better.”
“Judging by appearances won’t get us anywhere.”
Father stopped the panda from suggesting retreat, and Ren and Itsuki agreed.
“Right. First, we should get closer and see how effective our attacks are.”
“Yeah, alright. Filolials and the soldiers of the kingdom, prepare for battle!”
At Ren’s words, the soldiers saluted and joined the queen in preparing for battle.
“Alright, Filolial-sama! Follow the older sister!”
“Yes!”
“You gluttons. This is the time to be useful.”
“I don’t know why Ren is acting all high and mighty, but everyone, please provide support. Sadina-san too.”
“Leave it to me! I’ll do my best!”
“Alright, everyone… let’s go! To minimize the damage as much as possible!”

At Father’s words, everyone present nodded. By the way, we heroes are taking the lead in battle. As Ren and Itsuki suggested, we want to test how effective our attacks will be. Though I’ve already said it’s a piece of cake. Perhaps due to the approaching Spirit Tortoise, its familiars are flying all around.
“Meteor Shield X!”
Father created a barrier to protect us.
“Aiming Lancer X! Hundred Swords X! Gatling Blaster X!”

Ren, Itsuki, and I unleashed wide-range skills, wiping out the familiars. My Aiming Lancer, of course, is a skill where I throw multiple splitting lances. Ren’s Hundred Swords summons and rains down countless swords. Itsuki’s skill seems to be a rapid-fire attack from a gatling gun. That alone wiped out most of the familiars. The ones we missed were finished off by the older sister and the queen while providing support with ritual magic.
“Alright! Let’s move in quickly!”
“Yeah!”

At Father’s command, we each advanced. As for the Filolials… I rode Sakura-chan along with Father. Ren and Itsuki rode Kou. The assistant and the mole rode with the rival, while Éclair was on another Filolial-sama. At first, the rival made a fuss about carrying Father on his back, but he lost the lottery, which led to the current arrangement. Serves him right. And so, we approached the Spirit Tortoise.
“Whoa… It looks even bigger up close…”
The massive head of the Spirit Tortoise loomed before us, and Father and the others looked up at it.
Is this our third meeting…? Familiars were swarming around the area. It would be best to engage them early. According to Father, this is the preliminary skirmish.
“Then, I’ll launch the first strike.”
“Got it. I’ll cast support magic just in case.”

Father focused his mind and began chanting a spell. ‘I, the Shield Hero, command the heavens and the earth, sever reason, reconnect, and expel the corruption. Power of the dragon veins, manifest alongside my magic and the strength of the Hero. I, the Shield Hero, command you. Read through all creation once more and grant everything unto him.’
“Liberation Aura X!”
The ultimate support magic cast by Father was bestowed upon Itsuki.
Now he’s a hundred times stronger!
“Thank you very much. I’m going in!”
Itsuki aimed his gun at the Spirit Tortoise’s head and fired a skill.
“Meteor Bow X!”

His gun transformed into something resembling a crossbow, and Itsuki released a glowing arrow. Stars scattered in pursuit of the arrow, striking the Spirit Tortoise’s head. With a splatter, the head of the Spirit Tortoise was blown away.
“W-What…!?”
Itsuki had fired the shot, stared in disbelief, looking back and forth between the Spirit Tortoise’s head and his own gun.
“No way… I did put a lot of power into it, but for it to go down so easily?”
With a thud, the Spirit Tortoise collapsed. Rather than the Spirit Tortoise itself, the dust cloud kicked up by the impact was more of a nuisance.
“Amazing. If you properly strengthen yourselves, it really is just a pushover.”
“Nano… Did Gaelion and the others even need to come?”
“The Heroes could probably handle this alone.”

The rival and the assistant were analyzing the situation. They’re not entirely wrong. But as Father always says, better safe than sorry. Ren and Itsuki seemed to agree as well. Relying too much on the Heroes wouldn’t be good for the people of this world.
“What about the familiars nearby?”
“The Spirit Tortoise fell, and they seem to be running away…”
“Then we should finish them off quickly.”
“Yeah. It’s a relief if the Spirit Tortoise was just for show, but this isn’t over yet, right?”
“Exactly.”
“The numbers and the hourglass haven’t disappeared from my vision.”
“The head will regenerate soon.”
Though I remained vigilant, the Spirit Tortoise hadn’t moved so far. It remained collapsed.
“It’s not moving at all…”
“This is strange.”
“It’s highly likely that it wasn’t at full strength yet.”
That’s right. We can’t assume it’s been defeated yet. Just then, the supporting troops who had been guarding the rear approached on the backs of the Filolial-sama.
“This is an anticlimactic situation.”
The queen spoke while holding her staff.
“Indeed. For now… we don’t know when the head will regenerate. We should head to the heart quickly and fulfill the conditions for victory.”
“Understood. Let’s split into a group to destroy the head outside and a group to infiltrate and destroy the heart.”
“How should we split up?”
“Motoyasu, you know how to get to the heart, right?”
“I do not.”
“What…? Why don’t you know? This is your third time, isn’t it?”

In both the first world and the previous loop, Father was the one who went to the heart, so I have no idea. When I answered that, Ren and Itsuki gave me exasperated looks. Then, for some reason, they both turned to Father.
“Naofumi, Itsuki and I will stay with the queen and monitor the outside. Can you go with Motoyasu to destroy the heart?”
“Sure, but why?”
“In case something goes wrong and we loop again, we want Motoyasu to remember the way.”
“And you’re the only one who can keep Motoyasu in check. You’re the best choice to go inside.”
“Moreover, the interior of the Spirit Tortoise is a confined space. Naofumi-san’s defensive abilities will be most effective there.”
Father nodded at Ren and Itsuki’s explanation.
“Got it. Alright, Motoyasu-kun, let’s go together.”
“Understood!”
“If Her Majesty is supporting the Heroes outside, then the older sister should support Naofumi-chan and the others, right?”
The older sister raised her hand.
Chapter 733 – Unpierceable
“Huh? Well… if Sadina-san wants to come along, I don’t mind, but… it’s pretty dangerous, you know?”
“Don’t worry. Big sis is strong.”
Father looked at the older sister and then shifted his gaze to the panda and his subordinates.
Next up was the panda, huh?
“Larsa-san, are you coming too?”
“I’d rather not, if possible.”
The panda answered while staring at the fallen Spirit Tortoise.
What is he so afraid of?
“Got it. I’m still a bit concerned about Larsa-san and the others’ levels, so it’s probably best to take a small elite group to the heart.”
“Gaelion and the others are coming, nano!”
At this point, the rival asserted himself. Sakura-chan stepped forward, unwilling to back down, and they stared each other down.
“Of course, I want everyone who’s been helping me as my companions to come along.”
No one objected to those words. Quite the spirit they have.
“Uh, Motoyasu-kun is a given. Gaelion-chan, Windia-chan, and Imia-chan seem to work well together as a team, so there’s that. Then there’s Sakura-chan, Kou, and Sadina-san.”
Éclair’s top priority seemed to be protecting the queen.
Second to that would be fighting alongside Ren, perhaps? Either way, it seemed like she wasn’t counted in the group.
“Big sis will do her best!”
“What about the Filolial-sama?”
How will they maintain order if the older sister steps away? It’s a rather difficult issue.
Are the Filolial-sama coming along in the first place? If they are, it’s going to get lively.
“Hmm… Yuki-chan’s absence is bigger than I thought… Queen-sama, this will put a bit more strain on you. Will that be okay?”
“There’s no problem.”
“Alright then. Ren, Itsuki, and Queen-sama, we’re going to head to the heart. If the head regenerates and starts moving, please handle it.”
“Yeah, we were the ones who asked, so of course.”
“Yes, since we need to destroy both simultaneously, the Heroes should split up. Naofumi-san, Motoyasu-san, best of luck.”
We waved to those who saw us off as we moved towards the fallen Spirit Tortoise’s shell.
“Ugh… Since not much time has passed, it’s still not as bad, but… this is a horrible situation.”

Father climbed the mountain that was the Spirit Tortoise with a pale face. Before entering the mountain, we had passed through the town that had once rested on the Spirit Tortoise’s back. Father spoke after seeing the pile of corpses lying there. Well, Melromarc’s castle town ended up in a similar state, so he’s somewhat used to it, but…
Father still seems to struggle with it. Most of them seem to be victims of the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars.
“Even so, Gaelion and the others have no choice but to move forward, nano.”
“That’s right. Big sis thinks so too. Thanks to Naofumi-chan and the others’ efforts, I’m sure there are lives that will be saved.”
“I hope so. So, Motoyasu-kun, did you find anything?”

It’s still pretty dark. I lit the way with magical fire as we climbed the mountain. Sakura-chan and the rival were also searching alongside me. If I recall correctly, there should be a cave that leads inside the Spirit Tortoise. In the first world, I remember passing by the Spirit Tortoise’s corpse that was being excavated near the castle town of Melromarc. I’ve never actually gone inside the cave, but I have a rough idea of where it might be. I’m relying on my memory since I could see the excavated path even from afar.
“I think it’s around here.”
When I pointed, the older sister shifted into her beastman form and focused her eyes on something.
“Hmm… isn’t it over that way?”
The rival and Sakura-chan turned around in the direction the older sister pointed.
“Found it, nano!”
“Found it!”
“Oh! Did Sadina-san sense something with echolocation or something?”
“Well, something like that, I guess.”
The older sister replied cheerfully. I can’t afford to lose here.
“Then I’ll take the lead into the cave!”
“Well, Motoyasu-kun is using light magic, so I’ll leave it to you.”
“Understood, ma’am!”
With that, I stepped into the Spirit Tortoise’s cave for the first time. If my memory serves me right, including the first world, Father has challenged this cave twice before.
“Uh… I have the map the queen gave us.”

Father held the map in one hand and pointed the way. I followed Father’s directions and eventually reached a slightly more open area. Even so, it was still a dark cave. By the way, the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars that appeared weren’t much of a threat to us. I took them down the moment we encountered them. There was even a familiar that looked like a yeti in the slightly open space… but I took care of that one too.
“For now, we need to find the path that leads deeper into the Spirit Tortoise’s body, which isn’t marked on the map.”
“Indeed.”
“We could split up to search, but… for now, let’s explore a little further. Considering that the path hasn’t been discovered until now, it might not be accessible by normal means. Stay alert.”
Everyone nodded at Father’s words and moved forward. We entered one of the many branching cave paths. Eventually, after moving forward a little, we hit a dead end.
“Nano…?”
The rival flapped around and looked upward at the dead end, then quickly returned. The ceiling doesn’t seem to be that high.
“A dead end?”
“Nano?”
“Hmm?”
Sakura-chan tilted her head slightly.
What’s wrong? Did she sense something that Father mentioned?
“What’s wrong, Gaelion-chan? Sakura-chan?”
“I don’t really know, nano. There’s something off, but I can’t figure out what, nano.”
“Yeah. Something feels strange…”
“Kou thinks so too.”
Sakura-chan, Kou, and the rival were all tilting their heads at the dead end.
Could it be that we hit the mark all of a sudden? Father seemed to notice something and carefully inspected the wall. The rest of us, including me, also began observing our surroundings.
“Imiya-chan, do you feel anything?”
Oh, asking the mole was a good idea. Considering her species, she should be knowledgeable about caves and soil.
“Uh, um… I do feel that something’s strange.”
“Naofumi-chan, Naofumi-chan.”
The older sister called out to Father at that moment. It seems she had been quiet because the rival was making a fuss.
“What is it, Sadina-san?”
The older sister pointed her finger downwards and gestured several times.
“There’s a hollow space a little behind where Naofumi-chan and the others are standing. It feels like it’s been forcibly sealed.”
“Here, is it?”
I thrust my spear into the ground with a solid *thud*. The spear pierced through something with a satisfying feeling of slicing through.
Suddenly, an eyeball-like thing opened up on the floor and began thrashing around. But since I had already skewered it, its resistance was futile.
“Oh!? So there was a camouflaged monster hiding here!”
“I didn’t notice it, nano! So frustrating, nano!”
“Frustrating!”
“It was really good at hiding, so maybe Gaelion-chan and Sakura-chan couldn’t tell without stepping on it.”
That makes sense. The rival is always floating, and Sakura-chan was only looking around, not stepping on the ground. Kou was focused on the walls, so he probably didn’t notice either.
“Then, I’ll finish it off! Burst Lance!”
With my skill, I took down the camouflaged monster.
“However… now that I think about it, if we unleashed a powerful skill from the cave’s entrance toward the heart, it seems like we could handle this.”
“Didn’t you try that last time?”
“I tried using Gungnir to pierce through the body by aiming at the head, but it didn’t work.”

Whether it was due to its extreme durability or its high resistance to instantaneous attacks, the Spirit Tortoise’s shell was incredibly tough. Its regeneration was also exceptional, so any half-hearted attack would just be healed. And because of the Phoenix, we couldn’t bring it down in the end anyway.
“Well, in the end, directly entering the heart seems like the fastest way—”
Before I could finish my sentence, the ground began to rumble violently.
